messages.subject: [IT] Scheduled DMS maintenance - Saturday 18 October
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

The document management system will be unavailable this Saturday 18 October from 07:00 to 11:00 for scheduled maintenance and patching. Please save and close any open documents beforehand. Email and calendar are unaffected.

If you experience issues after the window, raise a ticket on the portal.

IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
